description: Create chatengine_lib.lua - the core library module handling message buffer, parsing, category detection, and SA-MP color code conversion
steps: Implement ring buffer (max 200 messages) with add/get/clear methods. Each message entry: {text, color, timestamp, category, parsed_segments}
Implement timestamp formatting function returning [HH:MM] using os.date('%H:%M')

Implement SA-MP color code parser: parse text with {RRGGBB} patterns, return array of segments [{text, r, g, b}]. Handle nested/sequential color codes. Default color from message color parameter (int32 from samp.events, convert to RGB).

Implement category detection function using string.find patterns: PM = contains 'Message from' or starts with PM format; OOC = starts with '((' or '[OOC]'; Action = starts with '* ' but not '** '; Ad = starts with '[Advertisement]' or '[AD]'; Server = default fallback
Implement color int32 to RGBA converter (SA-MP sends ARGB as int32, need to extract R,G,B components)
Implement filter function that returns messages matching a category (or all)
Export module table with all public functions: addMessage, getMessages, getFilteredMessages, parseColorCodes, detectCategory, colorToRGBA, clearMessages, getBufferSize
acceptance_criteria: chatengine_lib.lua exists at repo root and has no Lua syntax errors
Ring buffer correctly wraps at 200 messages (oldest dropped when full)
Color code parser correctly splits '{FF0000}Hello {00FF00}World' into [{text='Hello ', r=1, g=0, b=0}, {text='World', r=0, g=1, b=0}]
Category detection correctly identifies PM, OOC, Action, Ad, and Server messages
Module returns a table with all documented public functions
verification: Run lua syntax check on chatengine_lib.lua to verify no syntax errors
